Descrizione

Êtes-vous intéressé à façonner la distribution de solutions de liquidité tokenized à l'intersection de la finance traditionnelle et de l'innovation numérique? Voulez-vous travailler avec les principales plates-formes d'actifs numériques pour fournir des solutions de fonds monétaires tokenisées de qualité institutionnelle? Êtes-vous motivé par le développement de nouveaux canaux de distribution dans un environnement de marché en évolution rapide?

Mansioni

- stimuler la distribution mondiale de fonds monétaires tokenisés et de solutions de liquidité dans l'écosystème des actifs numériques
- établir, structurer et mettre en œuvre des partenariats de distribution avec des plates-formes d'actifs numériques centralisées et décentralisées, telles que les échanges, les portefeuilles, les dépositaires, les émetteurs de pièces stables et les participants à DeFi
- développer et exécuter la stratégie de marché globale pour des solutions de liquidité tokenisées
- entraîner des entrées dans des fonds du marché monétaire tokenisés et des mécanismes de liquidité connexes
- conseiller les partenaires sur les cas de trésorerie, de rendement, de règlement et d'utilisation des garanties, y compris les solutions de liquidité en chaîne et hors chaîne
- agir en tant que conseiller de confiance en matière de gestion de la liquidité sur les marchés d'actifs numériques, en fournissant des informations sur le développement, la tarification et le positionnement des produits

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you comfortable working in a second line of defense role, able to provide independent analysis and an “effective challenge” to the 1LoD, while remaining pragmatic? Are you able to react quickly and with sound judgment, balancing business objectives with legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements? In this role, you will support second line of defense (2LoD) Operational Risk and Compliance activities for Global Wealth Management (GWM) as well as for support functions (HR, Finance, Operations, etc.). You will work under the supervision of the Head of Operational Risk Control (ORC) and senior team members, contributing to risk monitoring, risk assessments, reporting, and control activities, while developing your expertise in non-financial risks. This role is particularly suited to a junior profile looking to build a strong foundation in operational risk, compliance, and regulatory matters within a structured environment. Your responsibilities
• Support Operational Risk Control and Compliance (second line of defense) activities for GWM and support functions at the local level.
• Contribute to the implementation and monitoring of the non-financial risk framework, in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Participate in key risk management processes (RCSA, incidents, Front-to-Back controls, risk appetite) and ensure escalation of identified risks.
• Prepare and consolidate reporting, risk analyses, and governance materials, as well as track remediation action plans.
• Support second-level controls, thematic reviews (AML/KYC, fraud, suitability, etc.), and interactions with audit and regulatory authorities.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms? We’re looking for an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain the extension of the functionality within analytics libraries used for valuation and risk management of UBS’ interest rate, credit, and hybrid derivatives business for business and regulatory requirements. Triage with the trading, IT, and control functions to provide support on modeling and quantitative matters.
• Provide analytical and quantitative support for trading desks that deal with several types of products including all linear interest rate products such as Swaps, Futures, and Government Securities; all Interest Rate Option products including Swaptions, Caps & Floors, exchange traded options; all Structured Rates products including Bermudan Options, Callable Notes, Range Accruals, and Leveraged Steepeners among others; and Structured Hybrid products including the underlying Interest Rate/FX/Equity indices.
• Code mathematical models in our C++ libraries and on tools using Python, Excel/VBA. Contribute to regulatory and model governance requirements by writing model documentation with technical/mathematical descriptions using LaTex and detailed tests using Python within our documentation framework.
• Provide support and input to the trading desk in usage of our stochastic-volatility Model, the SABR model, and related risk functionality including interest rate volatility risk, skew/smile, and interest rate risk measures. Support the interest rate options trading desk’s end of day model publishing and calibration processes. Tasked with investigations of day-to-day risk-based P&L attribution and explanation of any unexplained P&L and for generating solutions and improvements.
• Work in Python to provide the trading desk with various visualization and relative value tools to aid them with the pricing and marking of models. Be involved with the migration of our books to a strategic trading and risk management platform. Implement new pricing methodologies and modeling enhancements to the stochastic volatility model and SABR model in our C++ libraries to support Options and Structured Rates businesses.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002879. NO CALLS PLEASE. descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

descriptionByLocale.it: As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by: Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly. Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise? We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives. The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Competitive Underwriter is responsible for pricing, structuring, and executing municipal bond transactions in competitive sale processes. This role partners closely with sales and trading to evaluate deals, develop bid strategies, and manage risk to maximize win rates and profitability. Key Responsibilities Deal Evaluation & Pricing
• Analyze municipal bond announcements for competitive bids
• Build pricing scales, yield curves, and relative value assessments
• Evaluate credit fundamentals, structure, call features, and investor demand
• Determine optimal bid levels balancing risk, return, and win probability Market Strategy & Execution
• Develop and execute bidding strategies for competitive transactions
• Monitor market conditions (rates, flows, supply/demand, comparable trades)
• Coordinate with trading desk on secondary levels and positioning
• Submit bids and manage award process in real time Risk Management
• Assess market and inventory risk associated with awarded deals
• Work with trading to hedge or distribute risk efficiently
• Ensure adherence to firm risk limits and capital usage guidelines Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with:
• Sales: gauge investor demand and pricing appetite
• Trading: align on secondary levels and liquidity
• Provide feedback to improve competitiveness Post-Award Execution
• Support allocation, distribution, and secondary market trading strategies
• Monitor performance of won deals and refine future pricing approaches
• Maintain records of bids, outcomes, and competitor behavior

descriptionByLocale.fr:
The Competitive Underwriter is responsible for pricing, structuring, and executing municipal bond transactions in competitive sale processes. This role partners closely with sales and trading to evaluate deals, develop bid strategies, and manage risk to maximize win rates and profitability. Key Responsibilities Deal Evaluation & Pricing
• Analyze municipal bond announcements for competitive bids
• Build pricing scales, yield curves, and relative value assessments
• Evaluate credit fundamentals, structure, call features, and investor demand
• Determine optimal bid levels balancing risk, return, and win probability Market Strategy & Execution
• Develop and execute bidding strategies for competitive transactions
• Monitor market conditions (rates, flows, supply/demand, comparable trades)
• Coordinate with trading desk on secondary levels and positioning
• Submit bids and manage award process in real time Risk Management
• Assess market and inventory risk associated with awarded deals
• Work with trading to hedge or distribute risk efficiently
• Ensure adherence to firm risk limits and capital usage guidelines Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with:
• Sales: gauge investor demand and pricing appetite
• Trading: align on secondary levels and liquidity
• Provide feedback to improve competitiveness Post-Award Execution
• Support allocation, distribution, and secondary market trading strategies
• Monitor performance of won deals and refine future pricing approaches
• Maintain records of bids, outcomes, and competitor behavior

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your role Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have strong analytical skills? We’re looking for someone who can: •assess counterparty credit risk using a solid understanding of hedge fund and family office risk management, trading strategies, infrastructure, and other quantitative and qualitative credit factors, including onsite due diligence •use delegated authority, within defined risk limits, to approve new positions or recommend decisions to senior credit committees, working closely with the business to ensure transactions align with UBS’s risk appetite
• •evaluate transactional risk across OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange-traded derivatives, banking products, and structured transactions
• •prepare, review, and approve annual counterparty reviews and transactional credit proposals, clearly setting out credit assessments, risk appetite, exposure drivers, and business outlook
• •lead negotiation of trading documentation, including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage, and Repo Agreements
• •manage regulatory requests, audit items, and operational risk issues in a timely and disciplined way
• •deliver ad hoc credit analysis and contribute to portfolio reviews to identify emerging risks and concentrations

descriptionByLocale.it:
Role Overview We are looking for a high impact Equity Advisory Sales professional to aggressively grow and scale our global markets franchise across the region. This is a revenue driving role for a proven producer who can deepen regional relationships with global clients, convert market intelligence into actionable trade ideas, and consistently deliver results. You will leverage deep market expertise, strong client connectivity, and strategic execution to position the platform as a core partner to primarily regional and global hedge funds. Key Responsibilities
• Own and accelerate growth of the key single-CIO platform hedge funds across APAC, with a clear focus on revenue, wallet share, and cross border penetration
• Be the primary advisor and solution provider to global clients, delivering differentiated market intelligence and sharp trade ideas
• Proactively originate, build, and monetize client relationships by deeply understanding investment objectives, risk constraints, and return drivers
• Stay ahead of market dynamics, regulatory developments, and product innovation, translating change into commercial opportunity
• Convert market events, research views, and positioning insights into actionable recommendations that help clients generate alpha
• Drive solutions in close partnership with trading, research, product, and structuring teams to deliver seamless client experience.

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are seeking a quantitative analyst to provide and support execution consulting, client analytics and transaction cost analysis (TCA) for the APAC Agency Algorithmic Trading platform. The role is analytics led and client facing, with responsibility for explaining execution outcomes and algorithm performance to internal stakeholders and clients. You will:
• Produce client facing execution analysis and TCA across APAC equity markets.
• Analyse algorithmic execution performance across benchmarks, market conditions, and execution styles.
• Translate quantitative results into clear, actionable insights for client reviews and discussions including practical recommendations on algo usage, parameter choices, and execution trade offs.
• Support analytics methodology, benchmarks, and follow up analysis in response to client and stakeholder questions.
• Work with Trading, Product, Technology, and Control teams to ensure analytics accurately reflect platform behaviour and client flow.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of production analytics used in client reporting, including the scaling and automation of the analytics - helping standardise recurring analyses, improve repeatability, and reduce manual effort.

Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé. • emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are looking for a Tax Specialist to join our UBS Asset Management Tax Team as an Associate Director. Specifically, the job holder is expected to:
• Collaborate with all business areas of AM across the US region to manage and resolve tax issues related to AM products, including the development of new products and providing specialized asset management tax advice on structuring and efficiency at the fund, investor, and portfolio levels
• Oversee annual tax compliance processes for various fund types (trading funds, private credit funds, fund of funds, mutual funds), ensuring adherence to all relevant regulations
• Manage and monitor FATCA/CRS, FBAR, 1099, and shareholder reporting for UBS AM Funds
• Serve as the primary contact for investor inquiries regarding tax reporting deliverables, ensuring timely and accurate responses and thorough reviews of investor deliverables (e.g., K-1 forms, estimated tax letters)
• Ensure timely filing of all tax returns and compliance with Group Tax policies and supplements
• Manage tax risk (financial and reputational) across the region, including, but not limited to: o Regular reviews and reporting of tax risk issues to the US Head of AM Tax o Implementing procedures and controls to mitigate tax risk o Monitoring tax and operational risk related to third-party service providers (fund administrators, advisors)
• Provide prompt and comprehensive responses to investor inquiries
• Support portfolio managers by addressing fund-related questions concerning jurisdictional requirements, diversification tests, and withholding tax matters
• Support business initiatives through the TRPA process, including pre- and post-launch conditions and coordination with Group Tax specialists for country-specific and indirect/specialist tax sign-off
• Manage the appointment and oversight of external advisors on tax matters, ensuring compliance with UBS internal contract management requirements
• Review of tax wording in fund documentation and other AM relevant legal agreements
• Build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments
• Engage the business in tax matters, reconciling the competing imperatives of the management of tax risk with commercial and regulatory drivers of the business
• Ensure that the AM business adhere to the Group Tax policies and supplements
• Manage various tax control and governance documents for US AM business including periodic update of the existing documents and creation of new documents where required
• Provide the business with regular updates and training on tax and regulatory developments
• Assist in regulatory projects where a tax expert is required (e.g. FATCA, CRS, CARF, s871m, Financial Transaction Tax)
• Build and maintain relationships with UBS Group functions (e.g. Finance/Legal) and other UBS divisions (Global Wealth Management and Investment Bank) to build the profile of AM Tax, and to ensure the transfer of knowledge for the benefit of the UBS Group In a time of increasing regulatory and operational challenge, coupled with a growing business globally, we are looking for an experienced tax professional who enjoys working in a dynamic and constantly developing environment. The job holder will be responsible for the proactive management and resolution of tax issues, as well as for the implementation of necessary procedures and controls regarding tax risk management in AM business across the United States region.

• Review of tax wording in fund documentation and other AM relevant legal agreements
• Build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Are you able to create ‎collaborative solutions in challenging and complex situations? If so, we are looking for a Client Coverage person for UBS ETF & Index Fund in Singapore:
• cover the strategic development and management of the ETF & Index Fund business Singapore and SEA region. Positioned within one of the key growth areas of the company, you will play a critical role in driving the growth and success of their ETF offerings, overseeing all relevant aspects of product development, distribution, marketing, and operations. This position requires a combination of strategic vision, market insight, collaborative mindset, strong leadership abilities and out-of-the-box thinking to position the UBS ETF & Index Fund business for long-term success in a competitive landscape.
• involved in development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for the UBS ETF & Index Fund business for Singapore, aligned with the overall goals and objectives of the firm.
• expand distribution channels and increase market penetration for UBS ETFs & Index Funds in Singapore through effective marketing initiatives, digital engagement, partnerships, and client interaction to increase sales growth, generate revenues and UBS’s position in the market.
• build and maintain strong relationships with wealth management, institutional and wholesale clients, financial advisors, and other key stakeholders to understand their needs and preferences, and to effectively position UBS ETFs & Index Funds.
• collaborate with internal colleagues regionally and globally including portfolio management, capital markets, marketing and product development and support the efforts of the generalist wholesale and institutional client coverage teams. identify opportunities for new UBS ETFs & Index Funds and develop enhancements to existing offerings, working closely with the investment, research, and product development teams.
• ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements related to UBS ETFs & Index Funds, staying abreast of industry developments and implementing necessary changes to maintain compliance.
• monitor and analyse the investment performance and sales results of UBS ETF & Index Fund products, tracking key metrics and performance drivers to inform decision-making and drive continuous improvement. Represent the firm in industry forums, conferences, and other events to enhance UBS’s visibility and reputation within the indexing marketplace.

title: Investment Banking Analyst - EMEA Private Funds Group

titleByLocale.it: Investment Banking Analista - EMEA Private Funds Group
titleByLocale.en: Investment Banking Analyst - EMEA Private Funds Group
titleByLocale.de: Investment Banking Analyst - EMEA Private Funds Group

descriptionByLocale.it:
You will join the UBS Private Funds Group (PFG) within Global Banking, with a primary focus on primary fundraising advisory. PFG provides global advisory and distribution services to private fund sponsors across private equity, private debt, infrastructure and real assets, combining primary fundraising capabilities with secondary and liquidity solutions. In this role, you will support the origination and execution of fundraising mandates, working closely with senior PFG bankers, global distribution colleagues and clients. You will play a key role in evaluating opportunities, preparing marketing materials, coordinating investor outreach and supporting successful capital raises. The role also offers exposure to GP‑led and LP‑led secondary transactions. You will be responsible for a broad range of execution, advisory and project management activities, including:
• working with senior PFG team members to evaluate prospective fundraising opportunities, including detailed analysis of client portfolios, track records, teams, strategies and market opportunities
• advising clients on fundraising strategy, including fund structuring, timing, investor targeting and legal and commercial terms
• articulating complex investment and marketing messages clearly and effectively to institutional investors
• leading the preparation of key fundraising materials, including private placement memoranda, investor presentations, due diligence questionnaires and financial models
• planning, building and managing virtual data rooms to support investor due diligence
• maintaining comprehensive fundraising trackers, coordinating investor outreach, managing feedback and producing regular internal and external reports
• supporting the organisation and execution of investor roadshows, liaising with global distribution colleagues and roadshow coordinators

descriptionByLocale.en:
Can you lead critical Product Control transformations?
Do you want to act as a trusted senior advisor, ensuring stability, control, and delivery during complex system integrations?

We’re looking for a senior Product Control role to:

• lead Product Control integration related to Single Booking and Brazil cutovers into global risk systems, ensuring continuity of financial reporting
• stabilize the Brazil Product Control platform during periods of heightened operational risk and transformation
• drive remediation of high severity defects, reducing reliance on manual processes and temporary workarounds
• ensure robustness of financial reporting, controls, and governance throughout system integration phases
• identify, manage, and mitigate operational risks, including the design and oversight of compensating controls
• act as a senior liaison across Product Control, IT, Finance, and other stakeholders to align local execution with global requirements
• support MLSI remediation activities and ensure readiness for planned closure in November 2026
• contribute to firm wide strategic initiatives such as legal entity wind down and application decoupling

• lead technical design and implementations of robust and scalable systems using sophisticated market technologies

• partner with other IT teams to enable and drive new solutions and architectures

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about providing a seamless client experience? Does documentation and reporting excite you? We are looking for someone like you to:

• provide administrative and operational support to Workplace Wealth Solutions (WWS) Branch Management and Retirement Plan Advisors, helping ensure a seamless client experience across onboarding, recordkeeper coordination, ongoing servicing, and reporting
• lead the new client onboarding process, including preparation and coordination of investment advisory agreements, account opening documentation, compensation split setup, and required compliance tasks
• manage recordkeeper onboarding and plan conversion activity, coordinating with internal partners, external providers, and advisors to ensure timely and accurate execution
• support non-investment related facets of client engagement, including participation on client calls, preparation of meeting materials, follow‑up items, and ongoing service requests
• create, maintain, and distribute branch‑level reports and business metrics, supporting visibility into pipeline activity, onboarding status, service delivery, and overall business performance
• serve as a central point of coordination between advisors, internal operational teams, compliance partners, and external providers to keep client activity moving efficiently
• maintain accurate records and documentation related to client onboarding, plan changes, and ongoing administrative activity
• identify process improvements and operational efficiencies to support a growing retirement plan business

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you interested in joining a team responsible for managing the full operational lifecycle of products traded by investment funds administered by UBS?
We are looking for an intern to join our Middle Office Funds team. In this role, you will:

• Support the oversight of onshore investment fund trades, including performing financial reconciliation processes
• Pre-match and transmit settlement instructions to domestic custodians across equity, futures, stock loan, and fixed income markets
• Analyze and resolve discrepancies in collaboration with domestic managers and counterparties
• Monitor and assess the impact of subscriptions, redemptions, IPOs, follow-ons, and other corporate actions
• Execute cash control processes for funds engaged in equity, futures, and stock loan transactions

descriptionByLocale.it:
The HOLT Portfolio & Quantitative Strategy Team in New York is looking to add a new member to the team. We’re looking for someone who can assist the team to:
• Leverage data from the HOLT framework to produce research reports focused on market themes, quantitative strategies, sector and geographic allocation, portfolio positioning, and the benefits of HOLT data.
• Conduct client portfolio reviews that analyze the fundamental profile of a client’s portfolio relative to a benchmark, helping clients understand the benefits and risks of various portfolio profiles and also discussing individual holdings through the HOLT framework.
• Conduct analysis using the HOLT framework to generate industry and company specific insights for clients. This entails building a sound knowledge of both the HOLT framework and the economics of various sectors.
• Understand market signals and how they apply to a fundamental and quantitative investment process.
• Collaborate with a wide range of teams within UBS (Equity Research, Wealth Management, Global Markets, etc.) to create incremental business.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you want to use your expertise and portfolio management knowledge to help the Credit Investment Group identify new investment opportunities? Do you want to be a part of a growing business within a well-established asset management platform? We are looking for a Credit Investment Group Portfolio Manager to:
• design and implement investment strategies for leveraged loans and high yield bonds, ensuring optimal risk-adjusted returns within the fund’s mandate
• manage exposures across CLOs and loan accounts, considering liquidity, credit quality, and sector diversification
• conduct thorough credit analysis on potential investments, including reviewing financial statements, covenant structures, and market positioning
• assess issuer risk and make recommendations based on creditworthiness and expected performance
• execute buy and sell orders for leveraged loans and high yield bonds, maintaining appropriate documentation and ensuring compliance with internal and regulatory guidelines
• monitor portfolio risk metrics, including exposure concentrations, ratings migration, and default probabilities. Implement hedging strategies as needed, and proactively manage risks associated with CLO structures and underlying assets
• track portfolio performance, benchmark against relevant indices, and prepare detailed reports for internal stakeholders and external investors. Provide updates on market conditions, portfolio positioning, and anticipated changes
• ensure all portfolio activities comply with applicable regulations, fund documentation, and internal policies. Collaborate with compliance teams to maintain best practices and address regulatory changes
• support investor communications, including responding to queries, preparing presentations, and participating in due diligence meetings. Articulate fund strategy, performance, and outlook clearly and professionally
• work closely with analysts, traders, operations, and risk teams to ensure seamless management of the portfolio. Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of excellence and integrity

descriptionByLocale.it:
Does financial management excite you? Are you keen to keep a track of financial markets and how events in markets impact the P&L and Balance sheet of trading desks? Do you have a curious mind and get excited about investigating complex issues, identifying root causes, and delivering solutions? We’re looking for a financial controller to:
• Accounting Knowledge of various Financial products over their lifetime.
• Implement accounting controls and manage their governance
• compile and analyze financial information for FX / Equity Derivatives / Cash Equities / SLF products, review daily P&L and Balance sheet controls and work closely with the team to resolve issue, escalate them where needed and be accountable for daily P&L and Balance sheet production
• reconcile trade capture system feeds to the general ledger and manage journal entries
• prepare financial statements and other financial reports for the business and external auditors
• collaborate on continuous improvement of quality, efficiency and effectiveness of controls
• comply with requests from internal and external auditors, Internal testing teams
• Innovate through agile working and automation
• Month end close of P&L and balance sheet, trial balance substantiation
• Knowledge of Tools Like Alteryx, Python, VBA, Power BI etc is an added advantage

descriptionByLocale.it: Are you passionate about global technology trends and uncovering investment opportunities, particularly within AI? We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious professional to support equity research and portfolio management efforts. In this role, you will: - conduct in-depth analysis of listed technology companies, generating high-quality investment ideas supported by robust financial modeling and valuation frameworks. - translate complex industry developments, especially within AI, into clear, concise, and actionable insights for internal stakeholders and clients. - actively monitor market trends and react quickly to new information, ensuring timely updates to investment views. - contribute to CIO Transformational Innovation Opportunities (TRIOs), house views, and thought leadership across global equities. - support portfolio management activities, particularly in AI-focused strategies. This role requires a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you will: - conduct in-depth analysis of listed technology companies, generating high-quality investment ideas supported by robust financial modeling and valuation frameworks. - translate complex industry developments, especially within AI, into clear, concise, and actionable insights for internal stakeholders and clients. - actively monitor market trends and react quickly to new information, ensuring timely updates to investment views. - contribute to CIO Transformational Innovation Opportunities (TRIOs), house views, and thought leadership across global equities. - support portfolio management activities, particularly in AI-focused strategies. This role requires a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about building scalable, intelligent AI models and agents that transform finance business processes? Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge AI technologies like Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI? Are you confident at embedding AI into business workflows to create measurable value? Do you like to be challenged and encouraged to learn and grow professionally? We’re looking for an AI Engineer to:
• design and implement AI capabilities (models, assistants and agents) for Finance
• develop capabilities and predictive models for anomaly detection, clustering, classification, variance analysis and forecasting.
• develop assistants and agents for contextual commentary generation, driver analysis and other actional workflows in Finance.
• build production-grade scalable AI solutions in a multi-agentic architecture.
• work with a global team of AI scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful AI products.
• take ownership of end-to-end delivery within a collaborative and agile environment.
• embrace complex business requirements and enjoy the challenge of translating them into intelligent solutions.
• work as part of an agile development team within a global technology team.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé. En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :
• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business? As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will be responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely settlement of daily processes to move funds between UBS and our card vendors. You’ll work cross-functionally to support operations by:
• Proven leadership experience, including coaching/mentoring peers, leading workstreams, and driving accountability for timelines and outcomes.
• Managing resolution of errors and rejections on card applications and communicating solutions and outcomes to branch staff.
• Validating card benefit and promotional requests for eligibility and processing redemptions.
• Manage with urgency the end-to-end card issuance process, including card production, personalization, and distribution.
• Reconciliation of multiple general ledgers used for card processing, researching and resolving outages.
• Accurate performance of card account maintenance requests.
• Coordinate issues to the correct system support, track for timely resolution and communicate to branch staff.
• Payment Research- to include unidentified payments, payment returns and payment reversal requests.
• Communication of errors reported by the bank to the branch staff to move the card applications forward (credit freezes, under 21 applicant requirement, additional paperwork for underwriting)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a thoughtful evaluator of risk who enjoys understanding complex business processes and products? Do you want to play a role in how a global organization strengthens its controls and adapts in a fast moving environment? As an Audit Expert in Group Internal Audit, you will:
• •plan and deliver high quality, risk based audits, applying sound judgement to generate meaningful insights
• •assess the design and effectiveness of internal controls, highlighting strong practices and where risks require management attention
• •use AI and data analytics to enhance audit work and develop data driven testing and insights
• •develop clear, evidence based audit findings and reports, escalating significant concerns appropriately
• •communicate complex topics in a concise and constructive way to stakeholders, helping promote risk awareness
• •collaborate effectively with peers across audit teams and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels
• •coverage may include (for example): financial crime risks (e.g., AML, KYC, sanctions, anti bribery & corruption)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a sharp evaluator of risk? Can you investigate complex situations and propose solutions? We're looking for someone like that who can:
• lead or conduct reviews and audits of specific business areas, provide practical, innovative and value-added solutions to issues identified
• drive or work as a team member on reviews and audits, including thematic and front-to-back
• analyze and assess risks and barriers to delivery assumed by both the business and support functions
• identify and evaluate the effectiveness of controls designed to address those risks
• prepare reports of audit findings for UBS senior management, monitor the results, risk profile and developments across Financial Crime Prevention and provide input for planning sessions
• successfully collaborate with peers in and across audit teams
• Builds-up and continuously maintains sufficient knowledge of organizational and governance structure, of products and processes, of legal and regulatory requirements, as well as developing professional skills and experience, to allow for an effective and professional mandate execution.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a sound knowledge of investment funds? Do you have experience in managing projects and like to engage with various tasks and people at the same time? Do you want to help us to manage our growing business within UBS Asset Management? We’re looking for a Product Manager to:
• Coordinate client projects independently front-to-back, such as investment fund lifecycle events (e.g. new share classes, new sub-portfolio, change of asset manager) with all stakeholders and the client. This includes project planning, communication and execution
• Support complex projects, such as the set-up of a new fund or mandate, their repositioning, merger or liquidation. Coordinate and manage a project stream or defined tasks such as operational implementation, depending on the project
• Act as point of contact for day-to-day inquiries related to third party investment funds and mandates from clients and client managers, providing high quality responses and solutions, both efficiently and effectively
• Manage recurring tasks with subject matter experts and stakeholders, such as reporting, distributions, budgeting
• Data management and maintenance required to manage our fund shelf
• Assume responsibility for timely completeness of processes and documentation, consistency and accuracy of data

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Premises Assistant Manager supports the effective delivery of day‑to‑day facilities operations by working closely with third‑party service providers to ensure a safe, efficient, compliant and engaging workplace. The role has a strong operational focus across staff restaurants, transportation services, hospitality, soft services, and general facilities management, while ensuring high service standards, cost control, and a positive employee experience. Key
• Responsibilities Facilities Operations & Service Delivery Support the day‑to‑day management of facilities operations, ensuring seamless delivery of services across the premises, including staff restaurants, transportation, housekeeping, mailroom, security coordination, and other workplace services Act as the operational interface with third‑party suppliers, ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed contracts, KPIs, and UBS standards. Monitor supplier performance, conduct regular service reviews, and proactively address service gaps or operational risks Vendor & Contract Management Support contract administration and governance for facilities-related vendors, including catering and transport partners. Track KPIs, SLAs, and compliance requirements, escalating issues where service delivery or safety standards are at risk. Assist with cost monitoring, invoice validation, and identification of efficiency or optimization opportunities Workplace Experience & Employee Engagement Ensure staff restaurants and transport services deliver a consistently positive employee experience, balancing quality, safety, and cost efficiency. Support workplace initiatives aimed at improving employee satisfaction, engagement, and well‑being. Health, Safety & Compliance Support compliance with local statutory requirements, building safety norms, fire safety, and internal UBS policies. Promote a strong safety culture across all facilities services and suppliers, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated proactively

descriptionByLocale.it:
"The FPSL Delivery Lead supports the delivery of the Financial Products Subledger (FPSL) capability within the ampliFi program, with accountability for ensuring that finance, accounting, and ledger outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, control standards, and delivery governance. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition for FPSL scope, while balancing delivery pace with quality, risk management, and stakeholder alignment. The role partners closely with Finance, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders to ensure high‑quality, on‑time outcomes and acts as a trusted functional representative for Finance within the FPSL delivery. Key
• Responsibilities - Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned FPSL workstreams or modules within the ampliFi ledger landscape, with clear ownership of outcomes. - Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations to ensure correct accounting treatment, posting logic, balances, and alignment with UBS ledger principles. - Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts to Finance, ensuring transparency and realistic commitments. - Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with particular focus on financial accuracy, regulatory expectations, and operational readiness, escalating where required. - Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery activities across Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams, promoting collaboration and accountability across organisational boundaries. - Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes. - Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of business scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off. - Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on financial continuity, accuracy of balances, and stability of controls, and supporting smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations. "

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are a group of professionals who enjoy identifying areas of improvement and engineering better solutions. As a crew, we do our best to create a supportive environment where each of us feel appreciated and have a chance to develop professionally. We are looking for candidates to take the role of Infrastructure Engineer and help us to:
• Engineer, test and deploy features and releases for the IBM (International Business Machines) MQ (Message Queue) product.
• Assist in keeping the IBM MQ Messaging platform stable, performant, secure and compliant with UBS policies.
• Design, develop and deploy the next generation cloud-based ecosystem for the IBM MQ product. The key responsibilities are:
• Develop and improve application hosting infrastructure services, with a focus on the IBM MQ product and its associated supporting infrastructure.
• Provide hosting and deployment services that are easy to consume and efficient to operate, both on-prem and in the cloud – making effective use of cloud capabilities on the Azure platform.
• Apply a broad range of engineering practices, in an agile context based on Scrum. From analyzing requirements and developing new features to automated testing, deployment, and operations. With emphasis on Gitlab, the key tooling.
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements.
• Build observability into our solutions to monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues.
• Learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

descriptionByLocale.it:
"The PaPM Delivery Lead supports the delivery of the Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM) capability within the ampliFi program, with accountability for ensuring that profitability, performance, and cost outcomes are delivered in line with UBS finance principles, governance, and control standards. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business model validation, data readiness, testing, and production transition for PaPM scope, ensuring that performance results are transparent, explainable, and fit for management decision‑making. The role partners closely with Finance, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for Finance and performance consumers within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements for profitability and performance measurement are translated into well‑controlled, sustainable PaPM solutions aligned with the target finance and analytics architecture. Key
• Responsibilities - Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned PaPM workstreams or modules within the ampliFi finance and analytics stack, with clear ownership of outcomes. - Contribute to and review functional designs and PaPM models to ensure alignment with agreed finance use cases, performance measurement principles, and cost and profitability logic. - Ensure that PaPM calculations, allocations, and outputs are transparent, explainable, and aligned with Finance expectations and management reporting needs. - Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across PaPM data sourcing, calculations, and downstream consumption. - Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on calculation integrity, data quality, business interpretability, and operational readiness, escalating where required. - Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution and alignment on functional priorities. - Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, finance principles, model design decisions, and change control processes across PaPM scope. - Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of business scenarios, review of calculation results, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off. - Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of calculations, consistency of results, reconciliation where applicable, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations. "

descriptionByLocale.it:
"The FPSL & FSDM Delivery Lead supports the delivery of the Financial Products Subledger (FPSL) and Financial Services Data Management (FSDM) capabilities within the ampliFi program, with accountability for ensuring that finance, accounting, and data outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, data standards, and delivery governance. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business data readiness, testing, and production transition for FPSL and FSDM scope, ensuring consistent and high‑quality outcomes across the ledger and finance data landscape. The role partners closely with Finance, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for Finance and data consumers within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into solutions that support accurate accounting, trusted finance data, and sustainable downstream reporting, while maintaining alignment with the target ledger and data architecture. Key
• Responsibilities - Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned FPSL and FSDM workstreams or modules within the ampliFi ledger and finance data stack, with clear ownership of outcomes. - Contribute to and review functional designs for FPSL and FSDM to ensure correct accounting treatment, posting logic, data definitions, and alignment with agreed ledger principles and finance data models. - Ensure that FPSL and FSDM solutions support consistent, reconciled, and reliable finance data for downstream reporting, controls, and analytics. - Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across FPSL–FSDM integration points and downstream consumers. - Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, data quality, regulatory expectations, and operational readiness, escalating where required. - Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution and alignment on functional priorities. - Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, data standards, design decisions, and change control processes across FPSL and FSDM scope. - Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of business scenarios, assessment of data readiness and defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off. - Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on financial continuity, accuracy and reconciliation of balances, stability of finance data, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations."

• Responsibilities - Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned FPSL and FSDM workstreams or modules within the ampliFi ledger and finance data stack, with clear ownership of outcomes. - Contribute to and review functional designs for FPSL and FSDM to ensure correct accounting treatment, posting logic, data definitions, and alignment with agreed ledger principles and finance data models. - Ensure that FPSL and FSDM solutions support consistent, reconciled, and reliable finance data for downstream reporting, controls, and analytics. - Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across FPSL–FSDM integration points and downstream consumers. - Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, data quality, regulatory expectations, and operational readiness, escalating where required. - Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution and alignment on functional priorities. - Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, data standards, design decisions, and change control processes across FPSL and FSDM scope. - Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of business scenarios, assessment of data readiness and defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off. - Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on financial continuity, accuracy and reconciliation of balances, stability of finance data, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations."

descriptionByLocale.en:
Data Steward create, maintain & provide access to data. They define key data under their management and implement efficient and effective data management process as well as adequate controls to ensure that data is provided in good quality and in line with UBS policies and commercial agreements.
Key Responsibilities
• Design implement and execute processes to create and maintain data
• Apply a broad range of data management skills, from information management, non-financial risk control, data quality issue management, data cleaning, data governance to ensure that data is properly managed, shared and preserved
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and policy compliance of data
• Design, build, and test data quality controls and business rules, monitor data quality and manage rules exceptions.
• Remediate data quality issues
• Apply concepts and assume responsibilities as defined in the Data Management Framework
• Document and continuously improve efficiency and robustness of data management process.
• Manage day-to-day stakeholder interaction.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization? At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative. We’re looking for a Product Manager to:
• co-develop a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap covering the full product development lifecycle (including creation, version and infrastructure upgrades, and eventual decommissioning)
• drive new products and product changes iteratively and continuously together with cross-functional team members in the pod
• act as product owner within an agile team, participating in agile ceremonies and ensuring the product requirements are clear to designers and engineers.
• ensure the product is being tested together with clients to gain insights and ensure readiness to launch before market entry (e.g., UX testing, end user testing and research insights)
• support pod Objective and Key Results and provide relevant product measurements and metrics to meet overall business goals
• ensure the quality and compliance of the product, from also a technical and non-functional requirement (i.e. production stability, performance, maintainability)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Onboarding KYC Operations Analyst will assist with the drafting and gathering of client documents and verification of client data via public domains and internal sources at a client level prior to final review by a KYC Operations Reviewer and the client-facing team. This research is performed to ensure a client’s KYC profile is appropriately updated and any discrepancies or issues with the profile escalated to the appropriate lines of business.
• Collection and Verification of confidential client data via publicly available and internal sources.
• Understand the firm’s KYC requirements when completing documentation inclusive of Customer.
• Identification Program (CIP), Simplified Due Diligence (SDD), Basic Due Diligence (BDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
• Take independent decisions consistent with client identification policy.
• Compare and contrast differences within KYC records, highlight and escalate any discrepancies.
• Meet firm wide quality standards.
• Exhibit the highest standards of customer service to our internal and external customers (inclusive of confidentiality).
• Communicating/escalating issues to management when applicable.
• Handling and maintenance of confidential client documentation.
• Manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment Service the AMER region and work closely with the onboarding teams to enhance the KYC standards of existing clients to new KYC jurisdictions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you highly organized, detail oriented, and committed to delivering high quality outcomes? Do you take pride in accuracy, timeliness, and strong controls? We are looking for highly motivated individuals who will provide reliable operational execution and support across WMA processes. In this role, you contribute directly to service excellence, risk reduction, and client trust by ensuring tasks are completed accurately, controls are followed, and issues are resolved or escalated appropriately. This role operates within clearly defined procedures and contributes to continuous improvement through observation, feedback, and disciplined execution. Key Responsibilities Operational Execution
• Perform day to day operational activities accurately and within defined timelines
• Execute tasks in accordance with documented procedures, policies, and control standards
• Ensure data integrity across systems, records, and reconciliations
• Meet service level expectations and support consistent delivery Controls & Risk Awareness
• Follow all applicable regulatory, compliance, and internal control requirements
• Identify breaks, exceptions, or errors and ensure timely resolution or escalation
• Maintain required evidence to support audits and reviews
• Contribute to a strong risk and control culture through disciplined execution Issue Resolution & Escalation
• Investigate routine issues using standard procedures and guidance
• Escalate non standard, high risk, or unresolved matters to senior team members
• Communicate clearly and promptly with internal partners when support is required Service & Collaboration
• Provide responsive, professional support to internal stakeholders and partner teams
• Build effective working relationships within and across teams
• Participate constructively in team meetings, knowledge sharing, and cross training Process Improvement & Learning
• Identify opportunities for process efficiency, error reduction, and quality improvement
• Suggest enhancements within own scope based on observations and experience
• Continuously update skills and knowledge relevant to assigned processes and products

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization? At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative. We’re looking for a Product Manager to:
• Co-develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out our digital platform solutions
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that require transformation and migration onto new platforms
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Assist with relevant data sourcing, ensuring compliance with the firms policies
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you looking for a new challenge within the fast-paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Are you curious, proactive, and always striving to bring positive impact to clients? We’re looking for a Tade and Client Service Specialist to:
• Support Client Advisors in UK & Jersey
• Process client orders on an execution only basis covering equities, ETF's, fixed income, structured products, FX options, SPI's and hedge funds.
• Ensuring that administrative arrangements and client-related processes are completed accurately
• Carry out daily transaction processing and complex troubleshooting in line with WMUK & Jersey trading rules
• Dealing directly with external and internal clients
• Ensure all risk management controls are adhered to in order to identify and mitigate any potential risk and appropriate management information (MI) is produced
• Manage the input and release of payments for the Jersey business.
• Perform call backs on payments that fall within the relevant thresholds.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The SAP Business Integration Lead (ED) is accountable for end to end business integration across SAP S/4HANA, FPSL, Group Reporting and SAC within the multi-year ampliFi program. You will be the primary architect of the bridge between banking finance operations and SAP technical execution. The role ensures that business requirements, finance processes, data, and SAP solutions are cohesive, scalable, and aligned to global standards, acting as a senior partner to Design Authority and program leadership. Accountable for ensuring functional integrity, data lineage, controls, and operating model alignment across the finance value chain for a complex multi-national Tier 1 bank. Key
• Responsibilities - Own end to end solution design and integration across Finance domains, ensuring consistency across processes, data flows, and reporting outcomes. - Act as a senior Design Authority partner, providing direction, challenge, and oversight on solution and integration decisions. - Translate complex finance and business requirements into integrated SAP S/4HANA designs. - Oversee integration between SAP and non SAP systems, ensuring clarity on accounting impacts and downstream reporting. - Partner with Functional, Data, Testing, Deployment, and Change teams to enable successful delivery. - Engage with senior stakeholders, providing clear insights on risks, dependencies, and design trade offs. - Translate complex SAP capabilities into business value and vice versa. - Shape and evolve the future state business integration architecture to support global rollout and long term sustainability. Required Experience & Skills - 10+ years of Extensive experience in large scale SAP S/4HANA Finance transformations. Global Deployment experience preferred. - Experience in SAP BTP a plus Banking domain experience (wealth management, investment banking, retail) - Experience with multi-GAAP and multi-currency environments - Strong finance domain knowledge (Accounting, Reporting, Controlling, Consolidation). - Proven track record of leading large-scale global finance transformation (Big4 or equivalent background preferred). - Ability to operate credibly at senior executive level, influencing and challenging stakeholders. - Strong communication and leadership skills.

Do you want to build your digital architecture skills whilst creating impactful applications? Are you interested in being part of an externally recognized engineering community with personal development at its core? Would you like to join a team that gives back to the community and engages with a diverse group of people? We are looking for a Digital Technology Architect to work with us to execute our vision and help us create an even stronger industry leading organization. Your role will include:
• Working closely with cross-functional team members in a pod or crew to improve (digital) products in line with our Digital Principles and architecture goals.
• You will be identifying, designing and developing n-tier architectures on different layers e.g., enterprise, data, solution, and technology architecture.
• You will also be consulting with business, technology product owners and architects, helping them translate our OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) into backlog items and driving architectural improvements into the roadmap.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you interested in starting your career in the financial industry and gaining hands-on experience in a dynamic and international environment? We are looking for an Intern to join our RTA (Registrar and Transfer Agent) team, where you will support the Investors team in managing shareholder activities and capital movements of offshore investment funds. Your main responsibilities will include:
• supporting the Investors team in handling shareholder requests
• assisting in the processing and monitoring of capital movements of offshore funds, including subscriptions, redemptions, dividend distributions, and capital returns
• supporting the analysis and monitoring of payments to fund service providers
• assisting in tracking and controlling revenues within the offshore fund structure
• interacting with external portfolio managers and fund service providers
• contributing to daily operational routines and controls related to investor servicing

• work in a dynamic front-office environment along with the trading desks
• assist in developing metrics and processes to mitigate risk
• assist in limit calibration for a wide range of clients
• monitor client trading activity and limits
• quickly solve trading limits related issues
• assist the team to perform risk analysis and deliver best solutions to our clients
• help to run and improve our reports, which cover pre-trading risk, liquidity risk, clients capital monitoring, end-of-day stress calculations and other risk related items
• interact with other UBS teams both onshore and offshore to ensure client needs are met.
• work on the resolution of non-operational client issues and complaints in accordance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Premises Manager is accountable for the end‑to‑end leadership, operational excellence, and strategic oversight of the UBS Hyderabad premises portfolio, comprising multiple locations. The role ensures that all facilities services are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and in line with UBS standards, while providing a high‑quality workplace experience for employees and stakeholders. The position leads the local facilities operating model, managing Assistant Managers and overseeing multiple third‑party service partners across soft services, engineering, staff restaurants, and transportation. The Premises Manager acts as the primary senior on‑site representative for facilities operations and is a key partner to local business leadership and regional GRESC stakeholders. Key
• Responsibilities Portfolio & Operational Leadership Lead the Hyderabad premises portfolio across multiple UBS locations, ensuring consistent service delivery, governance, and compliance across sites. Provide overall direction, prioritization, and decision‑making for all facilities operations, balancing service quality, cost efficiency, safety, and employee experience. Act as the senior escalation point for operational, safety, service, and vendor‑related issues across the portfolio. Team Leadership & Organization Lead and develop the local Facilities team, including Premises Assistant Managers, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight. Establish a strong “one‑team” operating model between UBS and supplier partners, reinforcing accountability, collaboration, and service ownership. Build succession depth, capability, and operational resilience within the premises management team. Vendor, Contract & Service Partner Management Own governance of all third‑party service partners across: Soft Services Engineering and Technical Services Staff Restaurants and Catering Operations Staff Transportation Services Ensure contracts, SLAs, KPIs, and compliance obligations are met consistently across all locations. Drive supplier performance reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and corrective actions where service standards are not met. Workplace Experience & Service Excellence Champion workplace experience across the Hyderabad portfolio, ensuring facilities services support productivity, well‑being, and employee engagement. Provide oversight of high‑visibility services such as staff restaurants and transportation, ensuring quality, safety, and reliability. Support workplace initiatives, events, and site programs in partnership with Corporate Services and local leadership. Health, Safety, Risk & Compliance Maintain overall accountability for health, safety, and regulatory compliance across all Hyderabad premises. Ensure compliance with local statutory requirements, building codes, fire safety norms, and internal UBS policies. Proactively identify operational and safety risks, ensuring robust controls, audits, and mitigation plans are in place. Financial & Commercial Management Own facilities operating budgets for the Hyderabad portfolio, ensuring effective cost control, forecasting, and financial discipline. Review and approve invoices, monitor spend, and identify optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or safety. Support business cases for investments, upgrades, or service enhancements where required. Stakeholder Management & Reporting Act as the primary Facilities interface for Hyderabad business stakeholders, site leadership, and regional GRESC teams. Provide clear, structured reporting on service performance, risks, incidents, and improvement initiatives. Collaborate closely with internal functions such as Security, Technology, Finance, Risk, and HR to ensure integrated service delivery.

The ideal candidate is highly motivated, exceptionally organized, and has a passion for helping others create sound financial plans. This position works closely with the senior Wealth Management Advisor in charge of planning for the team. Responsibilities include:
• Engaging with clients and prospects to help them understand and articulate their financial goals with respect to retirement, education, wealth preservation, and other.
• Developing coherent and realistic financial plans that address the interrelated concerns – risk tolerance, growth requirements, time frames, investment instruments and structure, tax sensitivity, legal/regulatory considerations, etc. – involved in complex planning situations.
• Quantifying and modeling financial goals to clarify and illuminate decision points for advisor use and presentation to clients.
• Collect and input data into a range of planning software. Create reports, spreadsheets, etc. based on that data for presentation to clients.
• Proactive collaboration with team members to maintain a positive, productive team environment. If you enjoy financial planning, and want to work with a respected, successful and engaged team committed to providing valuable, top-tier, planning advice to others, this position may be the one for you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
We’re looking for a quantitative analyst to support algorithmic trading platform and client analytics and quantitative configuration across APAC markets. The role combines platform level quantitative work with production analytics, transaction cost analysis (TCA), and client facing performance review support. You will:
• Develop and maintain quantitative frameworks that influence algorithmic trading behaviour, including market specific configuration and analytics logic.
• Enhance analytics pipelines used for algorithm monitoring and performance analysis, including helping drive data availability and re processing requirements with relevant data teams.
• Perform execution performance analysis and transaction cost analysis (TCA) for internal and client facing reviews.
• Analyse execution behaviour across market conditions, arrival times, and execution styles, translating results into clear, actionable insights, client specific and broader platform / algo improvements and internalization.
• Support methodology discussions and follow up analysis related to analytics outputs and benchmarks as well as providing market microstructure based insights.
• Partner with Trading, Product, Technology, and Control teams to ensure analytics outputs align with platform behaviour and business requirements.
