descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about data engineering? Are you keen to manage data that can materially help teams improve the way they work? You have the opportunity to join the team working on the new DevLens initiative, an ambitious data initiative to help our 40,000 IT employees organization accelerate value delivery to customers, improve organization efficiency and developer experience. Together with your team you will contribute to building and maintaining innovative data products spanning all engineering activities across UBS IT lines of business. You will work with large delta tables on Azure Databricks with Dagster, AKS, PySpark & SparkSQL, Confluent Kafka, REST APIs, database platforms, serving data products on Starburst/Trino data mesh. We’re looking for a passionate Data Engineer to:
• Develop, support and improve data pipelines and data products with attention to governance including sourcing, lineage, modelling, security, quality, distribution and efficiency
• Automate testing & deployment where possible using CI/CD pipelines
• Build observability to monitor and resolve production issues
• Analyse and organize raw data and be able to combine multiple datasets of varying quality
• Take ownership and drive deliveries within a supportive team environment
• Follow engineering best practices, and ensure bank & regulatory compliance across the lifecycle
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions, promote re-use where possible.
• Help manage the department data inventory and data products
• Provide data support to internal & external stakeholders
• Be comfortable within a geographically spread, fast-moving Agile team
• Continuously up-skill, learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

descriptionByLocale.it: We are seeking an experienced SAP Fioneer Financial Control (FC) functional consultant to support the implementation and optimization of the financial control process. The role requires a strong blend of functional expertise, stakeholder engagement, and SAP product knowledge to translate business requirements into effective solutions. The position will play a critical role in driving the design, implementation and adoption of the Fioneer financial control module, while ensuring alignment with broader SAP finance architecture.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Fioneer Financial Control (FC) functional consultant to support the implementation and optimization of the financial control process. The role requires a strong blend of functional expertise, stakeholder engagement, and SAP product knowledge to translate business requirements into effective solutions. The position will play a critical role in driving the design, implementation and adoption of the Fioneer financial control module, while ensuring alignment with broader SAP finance architecture. Key Responsibilities
• Lead and support the implementation of SAP Fioneer Financial control module, including requirement gathering, solution design and deployment.
• Engage with business stakeholders to understand financial control requirements, pain points, and improvement opportunities.
• Translate business needs into functional specifications and solution designs
• Provide subject matter expertise on financial control processes (reconciliation, substantiation, reporting)
• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure accurate system configuration and integration.
• Evaluate existing processes and recommend best practices and optimization opportunities.
• Support UAT, training, and post implementation stabilization.
• Support the transition from legacy financial control systems to SAP Fioneer financial control including process assessment, gap analysis and migration support.
• Partner with vendor to drive co-innovation and solution enhancements aligned and business and control requirements.
• Act as a bridge between business and IT teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
• Provide inputs on data models, controls, and governance frameworks related to financial control.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a passion for analyzing financial data and related information to solve varying and complex suitability and conflicts of interest related issues before taking on new business? Are you able to manage complex and varied projects in an efficient and effective manner under a compressed timeline? Are you able to liaise with people globally? The BSRRC Specialist is expected to:
• take an active, leadership role in the conflict clearance and business selection process
• liaise with the Global Banking business to gather relevant details and perform conflict checks
• identify and resolve complex issues arising during the conflict check process while managing deal teams’ expectations around outcome and turnaround time
• lead strategic projects (e.g., enhanced automation and streamlining of processes, banker training, etc.)
• work closely with Compliance and Operational Risk Control on audit and regulatory issues and responses when required
• generate new ideas and creative approaches that help push the business forward
• make sound and balanced judgments (and always within professional, ethical, regulatory and legal standards)
• motivate and inspire others by providing a vision of shared goals
• train, mentor and develop the junior members of the team

• translate detailed fundamental analysis into clear investment recommendations that support portfolio decisions
• partner closely with portfolio managers to move ideas from research into our portfolios

• communicate insights clearly and succinctly through written notes and presentations to colleagues and clients

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Authorized Officer, Operational Risk and Data Specialist in Weehawken, NJ Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? We’re looking for an Authorized Officer, Operational Risk and Data Specialist to:
• Support and coordinate the preparation of regulatory operational risk reports and metrics. Perform analytical reviews, including data analysis and creating presentations of key operational risk metrics to senior management.
• Triage with other teams globally to ensure an efficient reporting process. Prepare and review the CCAR quarterly reporting submissions to respective supervisory authorities.

• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001683. NO CALLS PLEASE. descriptionByLocale.it: As APAC Regional Lead for Market Engineering Technology, you will serve as the senior technology executive and primary business interface accountable for Agency Trading Market Engineering platforms across APAC, with leadership responsibility for Agency Trading Technology in Hong Kong. This role carries end to end accountability for platform performance, resilience, and regulatory standing, ensuring that technology is a differentiating enabler of front office trading while operating within the firm’s risk and control framework. You will operate at the intersection of engineering leadership, business partnership, and regulatory accountability, shaping both the technical direction and organizational capability required to support high volume, low latency trading in complex APAC markets. Acting as the regional face of Technology, you will lead through senior leaders, influence global direction, and serve as the ultimate escalation authority for material delivery, production risk, and regulatory matters.

Do you like to contribute to great client experience and to interact with sales colleagues globally? Is a client-oriented mindset important to you and your trademark? • Act as the main point of contact for client inquiries, coordinate responses with internal teams, manage complaints, and ensure client satisfaction by delivering timely and accurate information and services.

• Oversee fee invoicing, trailer fee approvals, payment coordination, and proactively manage outstanding invoices (aged debtors).
• Execute processes and controls in a timely, accurate, and complete manner and ensure compliance with regulations and manage audit requests.
• Contribute to and potentially lead projects to further improve the Client Service function.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you interested in ESG analysis that directly influences credit decisions? Are you motivated by contributing your expertise within a collaborative, global team environment? We are looking for ESG Analyst to:
• working alongside credit analysts in the US and UK to assess material ESG risks and opportunities for loan and bond issuers
• developing and maintaining issuer level ESG assessments and ratings, with clear documentation of key risk drivers and rationale
• presenting ESG analysis and ratings to the ESG Committee and responding to feedback as part of formal review processes
• conducting reputational risk assessments, including evaluation of controversies, governance concerns, and emerging ESG issues
• monitoring ESG risks through news flow, regulatory developments, and external events, proactively flagging material developments
• supporting industry level ESG research, including identification of sector specific ESG risk themes and trends

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about the intersection of law and cutting-edge technology? Join us and be a part of the transformation in the financial market. We are looking for a seasoned lawyer with excellent collaboration and communication skills, experienced in exploring and shaping the intersection of law and emerging technology in the financial industry. Provide strategic legal advice on the implementation and roll-out of emerging technologies (primarily AI and Distributed Ledger Technologies such as Crypto, Stablecoins and tokenized assets). Collaborate seamlessly regionally and globally within the legal department and other control functions to unlock emerging technology's potential as a differentiator. Stay ahead of related regulatory changes and provide expert legal advocacy support. For this role you need
• an analytical and curious mindset paired with strong academic skills. Given the evolving nature of regulations and the lack of established case law, it is essential to navigate unprecedented scenarios with sound judgment, anticipating how regulators will likely assess emerging issues.
• strong drafting and communication skills, including a clear and concise communication style.
• to be able to excel in a fast-paced, global environment, working independently and as a key team partner.
• to be collaborative, proactive and adaptable, with a proven legal track record in advising on use of emerging technology in the financial industry.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS is seeking an intellectually curious and analytically driven individual to join our US Rates Strategy team. This role sits at the intersection of markets, economics, and quantitative analysis, with responsibility for translating complex data into clear, compelling insights to inform clients and internal stakeholders. In this role, you will:
• Produce timely, high-quality research notes and strategy pieces on US rates markets, covering a broad range of topics including Treasury supply and demand dynamics, market structure, positioning, technicals, and yield curve analysis
• Build and maintain quantitative models to analyze interest rate dynamics and support trade recommendations
• Collaborate closely with sales, trading, and other research desks to ensure strategy content is relevant, well-distributed, and effectively communicated to clients
• Monitor and respond to developments in US and global macro markets with well-reasoned, clearly communicated analysis

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you want to design and build attractive digital products and services? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization? We’re building modern, secure, and elegant digital products for our Wealth Management business users. As a React / Full Stack Engineer, you’ll design and ship end to end features, modernize our UI, integrate with resilient back end services, and help evolve our platform for the cloud. You’ll work in a collaborative, agile environment and play an active role in technical decisions, architecture patterns, and engineering culture. What you’ll do:
• Build and integrate a new ReactJS-based UI with backend services, implementing key business functionality and preparing applications for the cloud.
• Own and deliver features end-to-end, from requirements to deployment.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, presenting work and incorporating feedback.
• Apply best practices in Agile and DevOps, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure solutions meet the highest standards of quality, security, reliability, and compliance.
• Write and maintain tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to improve code coverage.
• Guide and mentor team members through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
• Troubleshoot and resolve frontend issues promptly, proposing effective solutions.
• Advocate for client needs and ensure user-centric design in all deliverables.
• Contribute to engineering culture and internal communities.

descriptionByLocale.en: Do you know how to keep an eye out for and avoid risk? Do you make sensible calls in challenging situations, including knowing when to escalate? Do you have experience in Control Room and/or Investment Banking and Research Compliance Advisory? We are looking for someone to help: • provide independent and timely guidance to the UBS Global Research and Banking businesses on issues relating to day to day business, new business initiatives, regulatory developments, interactions with Banking and other parties outside Research; • maintain the quality of the information barriers applicable to the public and private sides of the bank; • assess regulatory requirements (e.g., ASIC, APRA, ASX or ACCC) to ensure compliance risks are identified, reported and tracked to their resolution; • analyse processes and systems and provide guidance to relevant stakeholders on the implementation of improved solutions that support business and mitigate compliance risk; • liaise with internal auditors on various requests in relation to compliance matters; • draft and deliver face to face training to the business; • review manuals and compliance notices to ensure they are properly revised or updated where necessary • draft new manuals, Compliance Notices, policies and procedures in light of regulatory amendments and/or business changes; • work with other members of the Compliance and Operational Risk Control team, locally and regionally to support the Compliance Framework; • respond to regulatory queries; and • perform local read across thematic reviews and assist with similar global reviews.

descriptionByLocale.en: Looking to start your career in a company that encourages learning and professional growth? Is your dream job to be a member of a global team that works in a high-energy and diverse international environment? If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS! We are looking for a Tech Graduate Program – Software Engineer working with key business stakeholders across the globe. As a part of your team, you will • Build tech solutions that solve real business problems and strengthen UBS’s position as a digital-first financial services company. • Understand and analyze what the business needs - for the whole firm • Design and deliver long lasting solutions using modern programming languages. • Give suggestions, and help improve current processes and tools. • Make sure everything is properly tested and controlled before it goes from testing into real production. Tech Graduate Program You will be participating in our immersive global graduate program. Not only will you connect with peers worldwide, it will offer you: Hands-on Experience: Gain exposure to a variety of tech projects from day one. Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay updated with the latest tech. Professional Development: Enhance your technical skills through training and understand our business. Guidance from experts: Receive insights, advice, and support from our experienced professionals. Environment: Collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas across organization. Career Advancement: 18 months comprehensive Tech Graduate Program kicks off in July 2026, ensuring your growth and success at UBS.

descriptionByLocale.en: • Do you enjoy creating and maintaining a strong and stable architectural foundation on which innovative, creative, and sustainable solutions can be built? Do you want to be part of an externally recognized community with personal development at its core? Do you want to join a diverse and collaborative team that doesn’t just focus on work? We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Application Architect with a strong background in Java, Azure, and on-premises solutions. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud and on-premises architectures, microservices, and API-based integration. • Solution Architecture & Design: • Architect and design enterprise-grade solutions leveraging Java, Azure services, and on-premises infrastructure. • Demonstrate knowledge of architecture patterns (e.g., layered, event-driven, CQRS), code-level patterns (e.g., factory, strategy, decorator), and data patterns (e.g., data mesh, event sourcing, medallion architecture). • Develop scalable, resilient, and secure API-based integration solutions for internal and external applications. • Apply domain-driven design (DDD) and microservices architecture to design robust solutions. • Define Azure Integration Services strategy using Azure API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Function Apps, and Data Factory. • Must be hands-on with Java and capable of designing high-throughput, low-latency systems.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Hai già esperienza professionale e vuoi approfondire le tue conoscenze nel settore bancario? Con il nostro programma di 12 mesi per consulenti clienti Affluent Talent, diventerai pronto per la consulenza clienti e otterrai interessanti informazioni su vari settori di attività. Beneficerai degli esperti e di una vasta rete. ## Cosa offriamo - un ampio campo di attività con un ingresso diretto nel settore del personale bancario - un onboarding dettagliato, formazione mirata e una rete completa - la possibilità di conoscere diverse dipartimenti e team all'interno della regione - mentre segui il programma, completerai la certificazione pertinente per la consulenza clienti privati e puoi facoltativamente frequentare il corso «Banking & Finance Essentials» al CYP, a seconda del tuo background professionale ## Compiti principali - Ti occupi e gestisci un proprio portafoglio clienti con clienti di investimento e ipotecari. - Raccogli e analizzai le varie esigenze dei tuoi clienti in modo preciso e li consigli competentemente. - Hai un forte senso delle soluzioni adatte e personalizzate per garantire relazioni clienti a lungo termine e acquisire nuovi clienti. - Ti avvicini attivamente ai tuoi clienti per creare un legame stretto e sfruttare ulteriori potenzialità. - Durante la tua consulenza, utilizzi anche strumenti e app innovative. In questo modo, porti i clienti con noi nel futuro: li incoraggi a utilizzare le nostre soluzioni digitali e li supporti in questo.
descriptionByLocale.en: Description Do you already have professional experience and want to deepen your knowledge of the banking sector? With our 12-month Client Advisor Affluent Talent Program, you will be prepared for client advisory and gain interesting insights into various areas of activity. You will benefit from our experts and a broad network. ## What we offer - a diverse field of activities with a direct entry into the personal banking sector - detailed onboarding, targeted training and comprehensive networking - the opportunity to get to know different departments and teams within the region - While following the program, you will complete the relevant certification for private client advisory and can optionally attend the «Banking & Finance Essentials» course at CYP, depending on your professional background ## Key tasks - You manage and process your own customer portfolio with investment and mortgage customers. - You precisely capture the diverse needs of our customers and advise them competently. - You have a pronounced sense for need-appropriate and tailor-made solutions to secure long-term customer relationships and acquire new customers. - You actively approach your customers to create a close customer relationship and exploit further potential. - In your advisory, you also rely on innovative tools and apps. In this way, you take the customers on our journey into the future: You encourage them to use our digital solutions and support them in this.
descriptionByLocale.de: Hast du bereits Berufserfahrung und möchtest deine Kenntnisse des Bankgeschäfts vertiefen? Mit unserem 12-monatigen Client Advisor Affluent Talent Program wirst du fit für die Kundenberatung und erhältst spannende Einblicke in verschiedene Tätigkeitsbereiche. Dabei profitierst du von unseren Experten und einem breiten Netzwerk. Was wir dir bieten: • vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet mit einem direkten Einstieg in den Bereich Personal Banking • detailliertes Onboarding, gezielte Schulungen und umfassendes Netzwerk • Möglichkeit, verschiedene Abteilungen und Teams innerhalb der Region kennenzulernen • Parallel zum Programm absolvierst du die relevante Zertifizierung für die Privatkundenberatung und kannst optional den Lehrgang «Banking & Finance Essentials» am CYP absolvieren, abhängig von deinem beruflichen Hintergrund Das sind deine Kernaufgaben: • Du betreust und bearbeitest ein eigenes Kundenportefeuille mit Anlage- und Hypothekarkunden. • Du erfasst die vielseitigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden präzis und berätst sie kompetent. • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für bedürfnisgerechte und passgenaue Lösungen, um langfristige Kundenbeziehungen zu sichern und Neukunden zu gewinnen. • Du gehst aktiv auf deine Kundinnen und Kunden zu, um eine enge Kundenbindung zu schaffen und weiteres Potenzial auszuschöpfen. • Bei Deiner Beratung setzt du auch auf innovative Tools und Apps. So nimmst du die Kundschaft auf unsere Reise in die Zukunft mit: Du ermunterst sie, unsere digitalen Lösungen einzusetzen und unterstützt Sie dabei.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Avez-vous déjà de l'expérience professionnelle et souhaitez-vous approfondir vos connaissances dans le secteur bancaire ? Avec notre programme de 12 mois pour conseiller client Affluent Talent, vous serez prêt pour l'accompagnement client et gagnerez des informations intéressantes sur divers domaines d'activité. Vous bénéficierez des experts et d'un large réseau. ## Ce que nous offrons - un domaine d'activités varié avec une entrée directe dans le secteur de la banque privée - un intégration détaillée, une formation ciblée et un réseau complet - la possibilité de découvrir différentes départements et équipes au sein de la région - Pendant le programme, vous complétez la certification pertinente pour l'accompagnement client privé et pouvez éventuellement suivre le cours «Banking & Finance Essentials» au CYP, selon votre parcours professionnel ## Principales tâches - Vous gérez et traitez votre propre portefeuille client avec des clients investisseurs et hypothécaires. - Vous capturez précisément les besoins variés de nos clients et les conseillez compétemment. - Vous avez un sens prononcé des solutions adaptées et sur mesure pour sécuriser des relations clients à long terme et acquérir de nouveaux clients. - Vous approchez activement vos clients pour créer une relation client proche et exploiter davantage de potentiel. - Dans votre accompagnement, vous vous appuyez également sur des outils et applications innovants. De cette façon, vous emmenez les clients avec nous dans le futur : Vous les encouragez à utiliser nos solutions numériques et les soutenez dans cette démarche.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Hai una personalità socievole che prende l'iniziativa? Ti motiva consigliare i clienti sulle nuove tecnologie? Per supportare la nostra crescita, stiamo cercando una collega o un collega che abbia un fiuto per le esigenze dei clienti e si senta a suo agio nel mondo digitale. Ecco le tue principali attività: - identifichi con precisione le esigenze dei clienti e li consigli in modo competente - hai un senso acuto delle soluzioni ottimali. Con questo garantisci la relazione con il cliente a lungo termine e segni punti con i nuovi clienti - nel tuo consiglio, puntiamo su Tools e Apps innovative. In questo modo, portiamo la nostra clientela nel nostro viaggio verso il futuro: ti incoraggi a utilizzare i nostri prodotti digitali e ti ci investi
descriptionByLocale.en: Description Do you have a sociable personality that takes initiative? Does advising clients on new technologies motivate you? Hier sind Ihre Hauptaufgaben: - Sie identifizieren die Bedürfnisse der Kunden präzise und beraten sie kompetent - Sie haben ein Gespür für optimale Lösungen. Mit diesem sichern Sie die langfristige Kundenbeziehung und punkten bei neuen Kunden - In Ihrer Beratung setzen Sie auf innovative Tools und Apps. Auf diese Weise führen Sie unsere Kundschaft auf unserer Reise in die Zukunft: Sie ermutigen den Einsatz unserer digitalen Produkte und investieren in sie
descriptionByLocale.fr: Avez-vous une personnalité sociable qui prend des initiatives ? Conseiller les clients sur les nouvelles technologies vous motive ? Avec ça vous garantissez la relation clientèle sur le long terme et marquez des points auprès de nouveaux clients • dans votre conseil, vous misez sur des Tools et des Apps innovants. De ce fait, vous emmenez notre clientèle dans notre voyage vers le futur: vous vous encouragez à utiliser nos produits digitaux et vous vous y investissez

Ecco le tue principali responsabilità: - Guidi e motivi il tuo team di dipendenti e li sviluppi ulteriormente - Supervisioni l'attività operativa quotidiana e applichi le normative di sicurezza - Rappresenti UBS nel mercato locale e costruisci reti - Implementi misure per trattare sistematicamente il mercato. Dedi particolare attenzione all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti - Eccelli nella consulenza competente e sei un esempio per i tuoi dipendenti - Applichi con costanza le tecnologie innovative. descriptionByLocale.en: Description Are you persuasive and success-oriented? Is leadership, coaching, and consulting your passion? Then get in touch with us. We are looking for a sales-driven leadership personality who will take the helm in our branch in Gstaad and have a flair for the needs of international customers in our tourist location. Here are your main responsibilities: - You lead and motivate your team of employees and further develop them - You oversee the daily operational business and implement the safety regulations - You represent UBS in the local market and build networks - You implement measures to systematically approach the market. You pay particular attention to the acquisition of new customers - You excel in competent advice and are an example to your employees - You consistently rely on innovative technologies. With them, you align your team/teams with UBS's digital transformation

Wir suchen nämlich eine verkaufsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit, die in unserer Geschäftsstelle in Gstaad das Steuer übernimmt und ein Flair für die Anliegen der internationalen Kundschaft in unserem Touristenort hat. Und das sind Ihre Kernaufgaben: • Sie führen und motivieren ein Team von Mitarbeitenden und entwickeln sie weiter • Sie überwachen das operative Tagesgeschäft und setzen die Sicherheitsrichtlinien durch • Im lokalen Markt repräsentieren Sie UBS und bauen Netzwerke auf • Sie führen Massnahmen durch, um den Markt systematisch zu bearbeiten. Dabei schenken Sie der Gewinnung neuer Kundinnen und Kunden besondere Aufmerksamkeit. • Sie punkten mit kompetenter Beratung und sind darin Ihren Mitarbeitenden ein Vorbild • Konsequent setzen Sie auf innovative Technologien. Damit richten Sie Ihr Team/Ihre Teams auf die digitale Transformation von UBS aus.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Êtes-vous persuasif et orienté vers le succès? La direction, le coaching et la consultation sont-elles votre passion? Alors contactez-nous. Nous recherchons en effet une personnalité à forte capacité de vente, qui prendra les commandes dans notre agence à Gstaad et aura un flair pour les besoins des clients internationaux dans notre station touristique. Voici vos principales responsabilités: - Vous dirigez et motivez votre équipe de salariés et les développez davantage - Vous supervisez l'activité opérationnelle quotidienne et appliquez les réglementations de sécurité - Vous représentez UBS sur le marché local et construisez des réseaux - Vous mettez en œuvre des mesures pour aborder systématiquement le marché. Vous accordez une attention particulière à l'acquisition de nouveaux clients - Vous excellez dans les conseils compétents et êtes un exemple pour vos salariés - Vous vous appuyez de manière constante sur des technologies innovantes.
